roleLabel: Melee Assassin finisher — Devour converts Omnivamp into execute damage and Shards on kill
bestFor: Runs that can feed him kills and Crit/Omnivamp so Devour snowballs economy and damage together
strength: Kill = Shards; Omnivamp multiplies Devour damage — successful executes fund the next spike
weakness: Needs a soft first target; if he never gets the kill, both damage and Shard lines stall

howToPlay.early: Do not start him as your only frontliner. Soften or peel so Devour can finish. Buy Crit/Omnivamp tools before raw Magic greed.
howToPlay.mid: Greedy = more kill Shards and cast-consume for permanent Omnivamp/Crit. Sanguine = teleport to lowest HP + Stealth on kill. Kingpin = Rush team Omnivamp/Crit per Shard for Assassin/Vanguard. Pick solo economy, dive execute, or tribal Rush.
howToPlay.late: Keep the kill train alive. Assassin Ambush/Supremacy pieces beat random Attack if Crit is low.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid-flank so he can reach the soft target after the tank engages — not the dive tile that eats the opener.

abilityNotes.Devour: Omnivamp is the multiplier and kill is the paycheck. Play for executes; whiffed casts on full-HP tanks feel terrible.

specNotes.The Greedy: Economy/scaling path — take when you can farm kills and want permanent Omnivamp/Crit from Shard spends.
specNotes.The Sanguine: Dive finisher — teleport to lowest HP. Take when you need him to find the kill without walking the whole board.
specNotes.The Kingpin: Assassin/Vanguard Rush tribal. Take with friends sharing Backup; weak as solo Dragomir.

relicReasons.assassins-ambush-engine-4003: Assassin engage/execute engine for Devour kills.
relicReasons.assassins-supremacy-filigree-3007: Crit/supremacy tools for the Omnivamp damage loop.
relicReasons.assassins-greed-banner-550: Economy fantasy that matches kill → Shard identity.

faq.question: Is Dragomir good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong when he gets kills. Weak as a pure opener tank. Shop rule: buy him when you already have someone holding the line.

faq.question: What class is Dragomir?
faq.answer: Assassin. Role focus: melee execute with Omnivamp scaling and Shard payouts on kill.

faq.question: What relics work with Dragomir?
faq.answer: Assassin Ambush/Supremacy/Greed pieces, Crit, and Omnivamp enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Dragomir?
faq.answer: Protect the opener, point him at soft targets, cast Devour for kills, and specialize toward Greedy economy, Sanguine dive, or Kingpin tribal.

tips: If he never gets kills, add focus fire or Sanguine — more Magic alone will not start the loop.
Kingpin without Assassin/Vanguard friends wastes Backup value.
